PUBLIC BY DESIGN — the /sessions page lists open semi-private sessions to anonymous visitors. The handler scopes the query itself: a signed-in caller gets their profile org, an anonymous caller must pass ?slug= or ?organizationId= (validated against organizations, else 400/404); coach credentials are stripped and rosters are served separately (members-only). See anonymous-exposure-routes.test.ts.
